name: Prickly Pear Margarita
desc: A bright magenta margarita made with prickly pear syrup, blanco tequila, lime and orange liqueur.

source.title: Prickly Pear Margarita
source.evidence: Exactly this recipe's ratio for one drink (2 oz blanco tequila, 1 oz prickly pear syrup, 1 oz lime, 1/2 oz Cointreau) with a kosher salt or Tajin rim and a lime wedge; this version is doubled for 2.

ingredients.raw: 2 oz prickly pear syrup or puree
1 oz orange liqueur (Cointreau or triple sec)
1 tbsp kosher salt or Tajin, for the rims
3 lime wedges, for the rims and garnish

steps: Rim the glasses: spread the salt or Tajin on a small plate. Run a lime wedge around the rim of 2 rocks glasses, then press the rims into the salt. Fill the glasses with fresh ice and set aside.
Fill a cocktail shaker two-thirds with ice. Add the tequila, prickly pear syrup, lime juice and orange liqueur.
Shake hard until the outside of the shaker is frosted, about 15 seconds.
Double-strain (through the shaker strainer and a fine mesh strainer) into the prepared glasses. Garnish each with a lime wedge.
tips: Homemade syrup (The Kitchn): simmer 1 cup prickly pear pulp (4 to 6 fruit) with 1 cup sugar and 1 cup water for 30 minutes, stir in 1/4 cup lemon juice, strain without pressing, and cool. It keeps 2 weeks in the fridge.
Garlic & Zest uses 3/4 oz lime per drink for a sweeter margarita.

references.title: Prickly Pear Margarita
